title: The Interior Seed Can Be Witness-Free: the Directed Door Count Over-States the Tucker Witnesses (n = 2)
description: The sibling entry oq-02-oq-08 proved that the directed pos→neg sign door rule drives the path-following engine's even/odd handshake to exactly three degree-1 disc rooms whose single door lies on an INTERIOR spoke — the conclusion the undirected sign-flip engine could not reach. But an interior degree-1 room is only the terminal room of the Freund–Todd signed pivot: its interior directed door coincides with a GENUINE complementary edge (λ u = −λ v, exact antipodes) for only some of these rooms. This entry quantifies that gap on the concrete hexagon and the answer is sharper than 'half': the interior directed seed can be ENTIRELY witness-free. The directed rule reads only signs (sgn : Fin 4 → ZMod 2), so it fires on any oriented +→− side; a Tucker witness needs the two labels exactly antipodal (Compl x y := x = negL y), strictly stronger than opposite signs. Complementary labels always have opposite signs (compl_imp_opposite_sign) — so the sign door never fails ON SIGN — but the converse fails two ways: opposite-sign edges need not be antipodal (+1→−2 over-counts), and Compl is symmetric while the directed door counts only the +→− orientation, so a complementary spoke oriented −→+ is not a door (orientation_blind_witness). At the antipodal labelling a = b = c = +1, d = +2 the directed rule still fires interiorDeg1 = 3 rooms yet interiorComplDoor = 0: NONE carries a genuine complementary door, because the centre +2 has its antipode −2 absent from every ±1 boundary vertex. Yet Tucker still holds — on the BOUNDARY: the edge v₂–v₃ = (+1,−1) is genuinely complementary (tucker_witness_is_on_boundary_there). The complementary interior count is not determined by the seed (0 at (+1,+1,+1,+2), 3 at (+1,+1,+1,+1)); it is a genuine function of the labelling while interiorDeg1 is the constant 3. Everything is decided by kernel decide over all 256 = 4⁴ antipodal labellings (0 axioms, no native_decide). This is the concrete, machine-checked reason the Freund–Todd identification of the pivot-terminal room with the Tucker witness genuinely needs the orientation-completion / boundary-accounting the bare interior seed omits.

mainTheorems.name: interior_seed_can_be_witness_free
mainTheorems.description: Headline separation. At the antipodal labelling a=b=c=+1, centre d=+2, the directed rule fires interiorDeg1 = 3 degree-1 interior rooms yet NONE of their doors is genuinely complementary (interiorComplDoor = 0): no boundary vertex is antipodal to the centre +2 whose partner −2 is absent. So the seed count 3 is not a lower bound on the true interior Tucker witnesses.

mainTheorems.name: hexagon_tucker_directed
mainTheorems.description: n = 2 Tucker in the directed hexagon model: for every antipodal labelling (a,b,c) and centre d, some room side is genuinely complementary — a boundary edge vᵢ–v_{i+1} or an interior spoke d–vᵢ. This is the true conclusion the seed-witness obstruction is read against.
mainTheorems.leanType: ∀ a b c d : Fin 4, ∃ i : Fin 6, Compl (V a b c i) (V a b c (rot i)) ∨ Compl d (V a b c i) ∨ Compl (V a b c i) d

mainTheorems.name: tucker_witness_is_on_boundary_there
mainTheorems.description: At the witness-free-seed labelling the genuine complementary edge the interior seed missed is the boundary edge v₂–v₃ = (+1,−1), not any interior spoke — showing the terminal room cannot be identified with the Tucker witness by the sign door alone.

mainTheorems.name: interiorComplDoor_not_constant
mainTheorems.description: The complementary interior count is a genuine function of the labelling (0 at (+1,+1,+1,+2), 3 at (+1,+1,+1,+1)) even though interiorDeg1 is constantly 3, so the sign-door count carries no information about how many interior rooms are true witnesses.

mainTheorems.name: orientation_blind_witness
mainTheorems.description: Orientation blindness, concretely: at a=b=c=d=+1 the interior spoke v₃→d = (−1)→(+1) is genuinely complementary but its directed door is 0 — the (+ → −) rule does not count the (− → +) orientation. This is how the directed seed under-counts complementary spokes.

mainTheorems.name: interiorComplDoor_le_interiorDeg1
mainTheorems.description: Pointwise domination: the genuine complementary interior count never exceeds the seed count, so the seed CONTAINS whatever true interior witnesses exist (an upper-bound envelope, not a lower bound).
mainTheorems.leanType: ∀ a b c d, interiorComplDoor a b c d ≤ interiorDeg1 a b c d

mainTheorems.name: interiorDeg1_eq_three
mainTheorems.description: The interior degree-1 seed count is the constant 3 across all labellings — the fixed quantity against which the variable genuine-witness count is contrasted.
mainTheorems.leanType: ∀ a b c d, interiorDeg1 a b c d = 3

mainTheorems.name: compl_imp_opposite_sign
mainTheorems.description: Complementarity forces opposite ZMod-2 signs: if x = negL y then sgn x = sgn y + 1. The sign-door heuristic keys off this necessary (but not sufficient) condition, which is the root of the over/under-counting gap.
mainTheorems.leanType: ∀ x y : Fin 4, Compl x y → sgn x = sgn y + 1

overview.historicalContext: Tucker's lemma (Albert W. Tucker, 1945) is the combinatorial heart of the Borsuk–Ulam theorem, the antipodal analogue of the way Sperner's lemma underlies Brouwer's fixed-point theorem. Its constructive proofs (Freund–Todd 1981; Prescott–Su 2005) proceed by an oriented path-following (signed pivot) argument: one follows a sequence of almost-complementary simplices from a forced boundary door to an interior degree-1 terminal room, which is asserted to be the Tucker complementary simplex. The sperner-mathlib4-oq-02 program verifies the abstract door-counting engine and the dimension recursion; the remaining obligation is the geometric door construction. The sibling oq-02-oq-08 fired the engine's parity mechanism on the concrete hexagon disc under the directed pos→neg sign door rule and reached a POSITIVE interior degree-1 count (exactly three rooms) — the structural conclusion the undirected sign-flip engine provably could not deliver. What remained flagged in that entry's honest status was the identification step: does the pivot-terminal room actually carry a genuine complementary edge? This entry answers that question on the concrete triangulation.
overview.problemStatement: On the standard antipodally symmetric hexagon + centre triangulation of B², encode labels {+1,+2,−1,−2} as Fin 4 with negation negL, sign map sgn : Fin 4 → ZMod 2 (±1↦0, ±2... {+1,+2}↦0, {−1,−2}↦1), and genuine complementarity Compl x y := x = negL y (exact antipodes). The directed door rule fires on any oriented +→− sign side; the interior directed seed (from oq-02-oq-08) is the set of degree-1 rooms whose single directed door lies on an interior spoke, always exactly three. Define interiorComplDoor as the number of those three rooms whose interior door is GENUINELY complementary. Prove: (1) Compl x y ⇒ sgn x = sgn y + 1 (complementarity forces opposite signs — the sign door never misses a witness on sign); (2) interiorComplDoor ≤ interiorDeg1 (= 3) pointwise; (3) at a = b = c = +1, d = +2 one has interiorDeg1 = 3 yet interiorComplDoor = 0 — the interior seed is entirely witness-free; (4) at that labelling Tucker still holds, with its complementary edge on the BOUNDARY (v₂–v₃ = (+1,−1)); (5) interiorComplDoor is not a constant multiple of the seed (0 at (+1,+1,+1,+2), 3 at (+1,+1,+1,+1)); and (6) an explicit complementary interior spoke oriented −→+ whose directed door is 0 (orientation blindness). All by kernel decide over 256 antipodal labellings.
overview.proofStrategy: The model is finite: four labels (Fin 4), six vertices (Fin 6), the antipodal condition forcing v₃,v₄,v₅ = negL of the three free labels a,b,c, so the parameter space is 4⁴ = 256 labellings (a,b,c,d). Every statement is a universally quantified or existential decidable proposition over that space, discharged by kernel decide (not native_decide), so the axiom profile is the foundational trio propext / Classical.choice / Quot.sound only — no sorryAx, no Lean.ofReduceBool. compl_imp_opposite_sign is decided directly on Fin 4 × Fin 4. intDoorCompl a b c d i is a Bool testing whether the interior directed door of room i (on spoke d→vᵢ or v_{i+1}→d) sits on an actually-complementary pair; interiorComplDoor counts int-deg1 rooms with that Bool true; interiorComplDoor_le_interiorDeg1 is decided by comparing the two Finset cardinalities over all 256 labellings. interior_seed_can_be_witness_free evaluates interiorDeg1 0 0 0 1 = 3 and interiorComplDoor 0 0 0 1 = 0 by decide; tucker_witness_is_on_boundary_there decides Compl (V 0 0 0 2) (V 0 0 0 (rot 2)); interiorComplDoor_not_constant decides the two witness values; orientation_blind_witness decides Compl (V 0 0 0 3) 0 ∧ dir (sgn (V 0 0 0 3)) (sgn 0) = 0. hexagon_tucker_directed (∀ labelling ∃ room side complementary) is decided over all 256 as the reference conclusion the obstruction is read against.
keyInsights: The separation is sharper than the 'only half' remark it sharpens: the interior directed seed count is the constant 3, but the number of those three doors that are GENUINE Tucker witnesses can be as low as 0. So the seed count carries no lower bound on the true interior witnesses — one cannot conclude a Tucker witness from the directed interior seed alone.

The witness a = b = c = +1, d = +2 isolates the mechanism exactly: every boundary vertex is ±1, so the centre label +2 has its antipode −2 absent from the whole boundary; no interior spoke can be complementary to the centre, so all three interior seed doors are opposite-sign-but-not-antipodal. Yet a +1/−1 boundary edge certifies Tucker — the true witness lives where the interior seed cannot see it.

Two independent failure modes separate the sign door from complementarity. Over-approximation: an opposite-sign side (+1→−2) need not be antipodal. Orientation blindness: Compl is symmetric but the directed rule counts only the +→− orientation, so a complementary spoke oriented −→+ is not a door at all (orientation_blind_witness at a=b=c=d=+1). The two effects push the door count both above and below the genuine complementary count.

The result is a positive scoping / obstruction certificate, 0-axiom by kernel decide on a fully concrete triangulation: it does not prove n = 2 Tucker (that is hexagon_tucker_directed and its siblings) but pins down precisely why the Freund–Todd identification of the pivot-terminal room with the Tucker complementary simplex is genuine work — the orientation-completion and boundary-accounting the bare interior seed omits are not cosmetic, since the seed can be entirely witness-free.

sections.title: Overview: Quantifying the Interior Seed / Tucker-Witness Gap (n = 2)
sections.summary: Module docstring and import (Mathlib). The sibling oq-02-oq-08 forced exactly three interior degree-1 disc rooms under the directed pos→neg sign door rule, but flagged that only some carry a genuine complementary edge. This entry quantifies that gap on the concrete hexagon and finds it is sharper than 'half': the interior directed seed can be ENTIRELY witness-free (interiorComplDoor = 0 while interiorDeg1 = 3), with Tucker's witness on the boundary. All by kernel decide over 256 antipodal labellings (0 axioms, no native_decide).
sections.mathContext: The result bounds what the directed interior seed can be trusted to deliver: the sign-door count over-states the interior Tucker witnesses, so the Freund–Todd pivot-terminal identification genuinely needs orientation-completion and boundary-accounting. Fully concrete (n = 2, kernel decide).

sections.title: Labelling Model and the Two Relations (Sign vs. Complementarity)
sections.summary: Restates the encoding of oq-02-oq-08: negL = ![2,3,0,1] (label negation on {+1,+2,−1,−2} as Fin 4); V a b c = ![a,b,c,negL a,negL b,negL c] (six boundary labels, antipodal v_{i+3} = −v_i); rot i = i+1; sgn = ![0,0,1,1] (sign bit); dir x y := if x = 0 ∧ y = 1 then 1 else 0 (directed pos→neg door). Adds genuine complementarity Compl x y := x = negL y (exact antipodes) with its Decidable instance, and proves compl_imp_opposite_sign: Compl x y ⇒ sgn x = sgn y + 1, so every genuine witness is a sign edge — the sign door never fails on sign, only on orientation.

sections.title: The Interior Directed Seed and its Genuinely-Complementary Sub-count
sections.summary: Defines intDoor / bdDoor / roomDoor on the disc rooms Tᵢ = (centre d, vᵢ, v_{i+1}) and interiorDeg1 (degree-1 rooms with their door on an interior spoke), restating interiorDeg1_eq_three (always three) from oq-02-oq-08. Then defines intDoorCompl (does room i's interior directed door sit on an actually-complementary spoke?) and interiorComplDoor (the number of interior seed rooms whose door is a genuine witness), and proves interiorComplDoor_le_interiorDeg1: the genuine interior witnesses are a sub-count of the three seed rooms.

sections.title: n = 2 Tucker in the Directed Model (Reference Conclusion)
sections.summary: Proves hexagon_tucker_directed: for every antipodal labelling (a,b,c) and centre d some room side — a boundary edge vᵢ–v_{i+1} or an interior spoke d–vᵢ — is genuinely complementary. This is the true n = 2 conclusion the obstruction below is read against; over all i the existential covers every spoke and every boundary edge of the disc.

sections.title: The Headline Separation: the Interior Seed Can Be Witness-Free
sections.summary: Proves the four separation facts, all by decide: interior_seed_can_be_witness_free (interiorDeg1 = 3 yet interiorComplDoor = 0 at a=b=c=+1, d=+2 — the seed carries zero genuine witnesses); tucker_witness_is_on_boundary_there (yet the boundary edge v₂–v₃ = (+1,−1) is genuinely complementary, so Tucker holds off the seed); interiorComplDoor_not_constant (the complementary count is 0 at (+1,+1,+1,+2) and 3 at (+1,+1,+1,+1) — not determined by the constant seed); and orientation_blind_witness (an explicit complementary interior spoke oriented −→+ whose directed door is 0).

conclusion.summary: On the concrete hexagon + centre triangulation of B², this entry quantifies the gap between the directed interior seed of oq-02-oq-08 (exactly three degree-1 rooms whose door lies on an interior spoke) and the genuine Tucker witnesses (interior spokes whose labels are exactly antipodal, Compl x y := x = negL y). It proves by kernel decide over all 256 antipodal labellings: compl_imp_opposite_sign (genuine complementarity forces opposite signs, so the sign door never misses on sign), interiorComplDoor_le_interiorDeg1 (the genuine interior witnesses are a sub-count of the three seed rooms), and the headline interior_seed_can_be_witness_free — at a = b = c = +1, d = +2 the seed still fires three interior degree-1 rooms yet NONE is a genuine witness (interiorComplDoor = 0), because the centre +2 has its antipode −2 absent from every ±1 boundary vertex. Tucker nonetheless holds there on the BOUNDARY (tucker_witness_is_on_boundary_there: v₂–v₃ = (+1,−1)), and the complementary interior count is a genuine function of the labelling, not a fixed fraction of the seed (interiorComplDoor_not_constant: 0 vs 3). orientation_blind_witness exhibits the concrete under-count cause: a complementary spoke oriented −→+ is not a directed door. A positive scoping / obstruction result (0 sorries, 0 axioms, no native_decide): it does not prove n = 2 Tucker but pins down precisely why the Freund–Todd identification of the pivot-terminal room with the Tucker complementary simplex genuinely requires the orientation-completion and boundary-accounting the bare interior seed omits — the seed can be entirely witness-free.
conclusion.implications: Converts the honest-status caveat of oq-02-oq-08 ("the interior door coincides with a genuine complementary edge for only some rooms") into a sharp, machine-checked separation: the directed interior seed count is the constant 3 but the genuine interior witness count can be 0, so no Tucker conclusion follows from the interior seed alone. This scopes exactly what the remaining Freund–Todd geometric construction must supply.
openQuestions: Formalise the orientation-completion / boundary-accounting this entry shows the bare interior seed omits: a directed door rule (or seed enlargement) whose fired rooms are provably genuine Tucker witnesses on the concrete hexagon, closing the identification step the n = 2 Freund–Todd construction still leaves open.

Classify exactly which of the 256 antipodal labellings make the interior seed witness-free (interiorComplDoor = 0) versus fully witnessed (= 3), and characterise the intermediate counts — turning the two exhibited endpoints (0 at (+1,+1,+1,+2), 3 at (+1,+1,+1,+1)) into a complete combinatorial description of interiorComplDoor as a function of the labelling.

Determine whether the same interior-seed / genuine-witness gap persists for n ≥ 3 (higher-dimensional Tucker triangulations in the sperner-mathlib4-oq-02 dimension recursion), or whether the boundary-accounting that rescues Tucker here is specific to the disc — deciding whether the obstruction is a general feature of the signed-pivot engine.

Prove the general antipodal-boundary obstruction abstractly: whenever a centre label's antipode is absent from every boundary vertex, no interior spoke can be complementary, so the entire interior seed is witness-free — extracting the mechanism behind the a = b = c = +1, d = +2 example as a labelling-level lemma rather than a decide over one triangulation.
